newsitem.title: DUBAI: Forwarders "to fight to deal direct with shippers".
newsitem.headline: Forwarders "to fight to deal direct with shippers".

text.p: Freight forwarders "will fight" to maintain their right to deal with exporters and distributors at a retail level, said Klaus Geissler, vice-president of leading freight forwarder Schenker International AG.
In a speech to the 18th Air Cargo Forum here on Monday he added that forwarders provided a better service than airlines which tried to deal directly with companies shipping goods by air.
"We will prove to each and every shipper that whenever the shipper believes he gets a better rate or service if he negotiates directly with airlines, we will prove the contrary," he added.
"Multinational freight forwarders are truly global operators...we have the best picture and transparency on the global networks of the various airlines and able to tailor-make solutions.
"Airlines still believe they are multinational but the networks of individual airlines have a limited range of routes, with the routes for cargo aircraft being even more limited," Geissler said.
He also outlined key elements needed for a successful long-term relationship between airlines and forwarders and said the most important was "no competition at a retail level".
"The airline undertakes not to approach the forwarder's customers directly. The forwarder specialises in selling and organising the transport service, the airline in carrying out," he added.
KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV cargo senior vice-president Jacques Ancher said the time had come for forwarders and airlines to be level with each other.
"As an industry we are losing credibility...and there will be fewer cargo carriers by choice in the future," he added.
"Our service levels are founding wanting. The integrators have the same ingredients for making the cake, but make better use of them.

Panel chairman Walter Johnson said the integrators -- such as Federal Express Corp and DHL Worldwide Express -- were the fastest growing sector of the market and had created a brand name for their products.
"Forwarders deal and work by the calendar. Integrators work by the clock," he added.
